member sees the message and no card or column form
add column: the new lane appears without a reload
add card: the card appears in the new column
edit and assign: the card shows the new title and the assignee
Move dialog: the card lands in In progress
move is announced in the live region
reload: the card is still in In progress
stale version: the 409 shows the board-changed message
stale version: the board refetched and shows the other change
after the refetch the region is no longer busy
keyboard: Enter on the Move button opens the dialog
keyboard: Escape closes it and focus returns to the Move button
delete: the card is removed
a drop on the end of In progress moves the card
reload: the dragged card is still in In progress
